evidence.title: Monthly Market Wrap: July 2023 - YCharts
evidence.summary: Provides the 30-year Treasury yield at the end of July 2023, which is the starting point for measuring the change in August.

evidence.title: U.S. Stock Market Rally Threatened by Rising Treasury Yields | Investing.com NG
evidence.summary: Discusses the 30-year Treasury rate pushing higher and potentially moving above 4.25%, indicating upward pressure on long-term yields early in August.

evidence.title: US jobs growth stays moderate in July, wage gains still strong
evidence.summary: Reports on July job growth and wage gains, which are key economic indicators influencing the Federal Reserve's monetary policy and, consequently, Treasury yields.

evidence.title: Latest CPI Report Offers Further Evidence Of Easing Inflation For Fed
evidence.summary: Reports on July's CPI data showing easing inflation, which could lead the Fed to be less committed to further rate hikes, potentially easing upward pressure on yields.

evidence.title: US consumer prices rise moderately in July | 1330 & 101.5 WHBL
evidence.summary: Reports on moderate rise in US consumer prices in July, which could influence the Fed's policy decisions and bond market sentiment.

evidence.title: Bond market sees no end to tumult as Federal Reserve casts a hawkish shadow | World News - Business Standard
evidence.summary: Highlights the hawkish message from the Fed and its impact on long-dated yields, suggesting continued upward pressure on the 30-year Treasury yield in August.

evidence.title: Fed done hiking; slim majority of economists say no rate cut through March: Reuters poll | Reuters
evidence.summary: Indicates that economists expect the Fed to keep rates higher for longer, leading to 'convulsions in bond markets' and pushing the 10-year yield near its cycle high, implying similar pressure on the 30-year yield.

evidence.summary: Provides technical analysis indicating that 30-year yields are consolidating above 4% and facing resistance levels, suggesting continued upward movement or stabilization at higher levels in August.
